# awesome-small-business-video

> Official, free resources for small businesses making short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and
> Facebook Reels: each app's help for businesses, music a business may use (TikTok Commercial Music Library, YouTube Audio
> Library, Creative Commons libraries), the rules for ads, endorsements, fake reviews and AI labels (FTC, TikTok, YouTube, UK
> ASA), and free editing apps and footage with their commercial-use terms. Each entry is the publisher's own page, with a quote
> and the day it was read in sources.json. CC BY 4.0.

- [README](https://github.com/viewgum/awesome-small-business-video/blob/main/README.md): the list
- [sources.json](https://github.com/viewgum/awesome-small-business-video/blob/main/sources.json): publisher, date read and quote for each entry

## Related

- [business-video-skills](https://github.com/viewgum/business-video-skills): short video plans and ad and claim rules by industry
- [ViewGum for small businesses](https://viewgum.com/for): short videos made for a business
